fields.description: The workbook (BOQs) this sheet belongs to.
fields.label: BoQ

fields.description: Workbook tab order; drives cross-sheet Excel-view ordering.
fields.label: Sheet Order

fields.description: Excel header row index.
fields.label: Header Row

fields.description: Number of header rows (1 or 2). Constraint enforced upstream by the parser; stored verbatim here.
fields.label: Header Row Count

fields.description: Opaque {COL: {role, area}} render map. Stored as-is; NOT re-validated against the parser ColumnRole enum (legacy maps may carry retired role tokens).
fields.label: Column Role Map

fields.description: Opaque {COL: header_text} map; may be empty {}.
fields.label: Column Headers

fields.description: JSON array of area names; may be empty [].
fields.label: Area Dimensions

fields.description: LOSSLESS snapshot of the draft's sheet_config as it stood at commit (R2, ADR-0014 D5). The six render-config values above remain the AUTHORITATIVE committed record for what they cover; this blob exists solely to preserve the parser-tuning keys they do NOT cover -- skip_top_rows_after_header, top_header_rows_override, rate_only_markers_override, level_1_style_override, and the frontend-only skip_row_definitions -- which a revision seed (revision_carry._committed_data_sheet, which inverts this snapshot) would otherwise silently reset to default. NULL on every sheet committed before R2: readers MUST fall back to the six columns, never assume this is present.
fields.label: Sheet Config Snapshot

fields.description: Per-(boq, sheet_name) commit version. Shared with the committed grid + nodes for the same commit. Set by the Phase-5 commit pipeline (Slice 3b). The sheet is now VERSIONED (freeze-and-supersede), not deleted on re-commit.
fields.label: Commit Version

fields.description: Exactly one current version per (boq, sheet_name). Enforced by the commit pipeline (the prior current sheet is frozen via frappe.db.set_value -- NOT doc.save, which would re-serialize the list-valued area_dimensions JSON and hit get_valid_dict's 'cannot be a list').
fields.label: Is Current

fields.description: Commit timestamp; set by the Phase-5 commit pipeline (Slice 3b).
fields.label: Committed At

fields.description: When this committed sheet's priced workbook was last exported (Slice 5a). Stamped per exported sheet via frappe.db.set_value at export time (NOT doc.save -- the list-valued area_dimensions JSON throws on a full save). Drives the 'pricing changed since last export' staleness signal (compared against MAX(BoQ Cell Pricing.priced_at) on the current version).
fields.label: Last Exported At

fields.description: Deliberate, user-controlled, per-sheet read-only lock for the pricing editor (the pricing twin of the review-screen 'Finalized' freeze). When 1, the SIX pricing save_* endpoints reject writes via _guard_sheet_not_locked. PERSISTED + cross-user; ANY user may toggle (no role gate -- a coordination signal). Stamped via frappe.db.set_value (NOT doc.save -- the list-valued area_dimensions JSON throws on a full save). Re-commit INVALIDATES: a new commit_version inserts a fresh BoQ Sheet row that defaults is_locked=0 (the lock does NOT carry forward).
fields.label: Is Locked

fields.description: The user who last set the lock (frappe.session.user). Cleared on unlock. Typed Data + read_only to mirror BoQ Cell Dismissal.dismissed_by / BoQ Cell Reconciliation Choice.chosen_by.
fields.label: Locked By

fields.description: When the lock was last set. Cleared on unlock.
fields.label: Locked At

fields.description: Deliberate, user-controlled, per-sheet classification freeze (the classification twin of the pricing is_locked). When 1, category verdict writes (set_row_category) AND re-classify (start_classify) are rejected via _guard_classification_not_frozen; PRICING stays fully live (this flag is NOT ORed into the pricing lock). PERSISTED + cross-user; ANY user may toggle. Freeze also banks a permanent BoQ Category Truth Snapshot batch (source='Frozen in product') + stamps every categorised eligible row's effective category into human_category_id. Stamped via frappe.db.set_value (NOT doc.save -- the list-valued area_dimensions JSON throws on a full save). Re-commit INVALIDATES: a new commit_version inserts a fresh BoQ Sheet row that defaults classification_frozen=0.
fields.label: Classification Frozen

fields.description: The user who last froze the classification (frappe.session.user). Cleared on unfreeze. Typed Data + read_only to mirror locked_by.
fields.label: Frozen By

fields.description: When the classification was last frozen. Cleared on unfreeze.
fields.label: Frozen At

fields.description: Admin-only, PERSISTED, per-sheet-per-committed-version escape from the rate-editable category gate (Slice G2b). When 0, save_cell_price REJECTS any rate write while >=1 rate-editable row (Line Item always; qty-bearing Preamble) has a blank RESOLVED category -- ABSOLUTE against the 'Price any row' priceability override (owner ruling; only the formula gate is also absolute). When 1, the gate is bypassed for this sheet+version. Set/cleared by set_category_override / clear_category_override (admin-only, _is_nirmaan_admin) via frappe.db.set_value (NOT doc.save -- the list-valued area_dimensions JSON throws on a full save). TEMPORARY BY DESIGN: to be removed once classification engines cover all disciplines. Re-commit INVALIDATES: a new commit_version inserts a fresh BoQ Sheet row that defaults category_gate_override=0.
fields.label: Category Gate Override

fields.description: The admin user who last SET the override (frappe.session.user). Cleared on clear_category_override. Typed Data + read_only to mirror locked_by / frozen_by.
fields.label: Category Override By

fields.description: When the override was last set (now_datetime()). Cleared on clear_category_override.
fields.label: Category Override At

fields.description: OPTIONAL short reason the admin recorded for the override (capped server-side at _CATEGORY_OVERRIDE_REASON_MAX_LEN, mirroring the remark cap). NULL when absent; cleared when the override is cleared. NOT read_only -- the admin authors it.
fields.label: Category Override Reason

fields.description: Per-sheet, per-committed-version switch for the BCS cost section of the pricing editor (slice BCS-S1). BCS is the COST side: two hand-typed rates per row (Supply + Install, stored on BoQ Row BCS Rate) representing what the work costs US, against the BoQ amount we charge the CLIENT. Enabling alone is NOT enough to write a BCS rate -- the two columns below must also be confirmed; the shared readiness predicate is bcs.bcs_is_ready. THIS GATE GUARDS BCS CELLS ONLY (owner-locked): it is deliberately NOT ANDed into save_cell_price's rate gate, so ordinary client-facing pricing stays fully editable on a sheet where BCS was never enabled. Set via frappe.db.set_value (NOT doc.save -- the list-valued area_dimensions JSON throws on a full save). Re-commit INVALIDATES: a new commit_version inserts a fresh BoQ Sheet row that defaults bcs_enabled=0.
fields.label: BCS Enabled

fields.description: The CONFIRMED quantity source for this sheet's BCS Total Amount, stored so it can be RE-RESOLVED later rather than re-guessed. A DICT (never a bare list -- a list-valued JSON field throws in get_valid_dict on a full save): {mode, columns:[{col, role, area, value_field, value_key}]}. mode is 'qty_total' when the sheet maps a scalar Total Quantity column, or 'qty_by_area' when it maps quantity PER AREA and the total is the SUM of that set. Each entry carries the full descriptor identity, so a reader resolves the value without re-deriving it from column_role_map. Validated at confirm time against the sheet's REAL column_descriptors (bcs.confirm_bcs_columns) -- a column the sheet does not have is REFUSED, not stored, and a scalar total may not be mixed with its own per-area parts (that would double-count). NULL until confirmed.
fields.label: BCS Quantity Source

fields.description: The CONFIRMED amount column for this sheet's BCS % Profit denominator -- the owner's 'Amount (Combined)', which is the amount_total descriptor. Same re-resolvable DICT shape as bcs_qty_source: {mode, columns:[{col, role, area, value_field, value_key}]}, a single entry. It records WHAT WE CHARGE THE CLIENT, against which the BCS cost rates are the margin. Validated at confirm time against the sheet's REAL column_descriptors; a column the sheet does not have, or a mapped column of the wrong class (a rate or a unit column), is REFUSED and nothing is stored. NULL until confirmed.
fields.label: BCS Amount Source

fields.description: The user who last confirmed the two BCS columns (frappe.session.user). Typed Data + read_only to mirror locked_by / frozen_by / category_override_by. NULL until confirmed.
fields.label: BCS Confirmed By

fields.description: When the two BCS columns were last confirmed (now_datetime()). NULL until confirmed. A re-confirmation overwrites both this and bcs_confirmed_by -- the pair always describes the CURRENT confirmation, never the first one.
fields.label: BCS Confirmed At

fields.description: For origin=revision sheets (ADR-0014 D2): the committed ORIGINAL BoQ this sheet's carry came from. Stamped per sheet on the committed BoQ Sheet at commit (S8) so a carried sheet stays auditable + stable even if the original is re-committed mid-flight. Null for upload/template sheets.
fields.label: Source BoQ

fields.description: For origin=revision sheets (ADR-0014 D2): the commit_version of the original sheet the carry read from (the is_current version at mapping time). Pins the provenance so it survives a later re-commit of the original. 0/blank for upload/template sheets.
fields.label: Source Commit Version

fields.description: For origin=revision sheets (ADR-0014 D2/D3): the committed ORIGINAL sheet_name this sheet was paired to (carried from the draft's source_sheet_name at commit, WRITE-ONCE). NOT an addressing key -- sheet_name stays verbatim (#152); this only records the cross-doc pairing. Blank for upload/template sheets and revision sheets declared New.
fields.label: Source Sheet Name
